items.label: Bike Repair Triage
items.summary: How a repair shop sorts incoming bikes into same-day fixes, booked repairs and referrals.
items.alt: An intake box splits three ways at a diamond: quick fixes go straight to a work stand, bigger jobs go to a booking calendar, and specialist work leaves the shop.
items.not_shown: warranty claims, parts ordering and supplier backorders, loaner bike checkout, e-bike battery diagnostics, wheel truing and spoke replacement, suspension servicing, frame crack inspection, custom builds, payment and deposits, customer pickup reminders, weekly tool calibration routine, shop safety walkthroughs, and the seasonal tune-up promotion that changes intake volume for six weeks every spring

items.label: Garden Watering Schedule
items.summary: When the drip system waters each bed, and how a rain sensor skips a cycle.
items.alt: A timer box feeds a diamond asking whether rain fell; yes skips to the next day, no opens three bed valves one after another.
items.not_shown: winterizing, hand watering with a hose, fertilizer injection

items.label: Kitchen Orders: From Ticket to Table
items.summary: How a restaurant order moves from the counter through the line to the pass: one ticket per table.
items.alt: Five boxes in a row from counter to table, with a loop from the pass back to the line labelled refire.
items.not_shown: allergy escalations, comped dishes, split checks
